name: Chunked Voxel Traversal
definition: A hierarchical spatial structure for sparse voxel grids that uses a 3D grid of 'chunks' (inner 3D grids) to skip empty space, combining the simplicity of a 3D grid with the efficiency of octrees by allowing large and small cells.
summary: Chunked Voxel Traversal accelerates sparse voxel ray marching by skipping empty fixed-size sub-grids, offering simpler implementation than octrees while reducing intersection checks in empty regions.
